description: A bounded Node 26 reproduction retains a stalled request; repeated interrupt mitigation and runtime recovery on both supported Node majors. Does not establish a hard elapsed-time bound or the precise native cause.

beforeNode26.protocol: Three sequential fresh processes; ten 1 ms pigeonhole requests each on one runtime, each followed by a satisfiable recovery check. A 15 s external process deadline retains partial events and terminates an overrun; it is a diagnostic harness limit, not an adapter guarantee.
